Hi Sara — thanks for the note and the priorities doc. Quick heads-up on scheduling: there is a DST change happening in Europe the night of Sun Mar 29, which creates a one-week mismatch window between US and EU offsets. That often causes invite times to display differently for EU attendees depending on client calendar clients/OS versions.

Your proposed Tue Mar 30 10:00 AM ET converts to the following on Mar 30 (post-EU switch):
- 10:00 AM ET / 1:00 PM PT (US)
- 15:00 UTC
- 17:00 CEST (London/Europe)
- 02:00 AEST (next day, Sydney)

Given you have Sydney attendees, that 02:00 AEST slot is not ideal. My suggestion: either move the demo out of the mismatch week to the following week (Apr 6–8) so local times are stable across regions, or pick a cross-region-friendly time the same week (e.g., 8:00 AM PT / 11:00 AM ET which is 16:00 CEST / 01:00 AEST — still late for APAC).

I attached a quick timezone conversion snapshot and can propose three slots for April 6–8 that should be reasonable for all:
- Tue Apr 6 — 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 16:00 CEST
- Wed Apr 7 — 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 CEST
- Thu Apr 8 — 07:00 PT / 10:00 ET / 15:00 CEST

If you prefer, we can also run a 30-minute session focused solely on the parts that matter to APAC (cost controls + private deployment) and follow up with a separate EU-focused session during European business hours.

Next steps: tell me which option you prefer or share a couple of windows that work for Tom + the Sydney team and I'll lock the invite.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
